title: Rent a JJ Chat
desc: A one-on-one call with JJ — honest, warm, a little funny, and never superficial. This isn't a flirty service or small talk session. It's more like a mini confession booth, a safe space to speak openly about what's really going on in your life. You can talk, vent, ask for advice, or even practice Korean. JJ listens without judgment and tells you the truth gently, the way a friend would — but better.
notes: This is a scheduled one-hour call with JJ.
Voice call only — scheduled separately after purchase.
No romantic or sexual content. This is a genuine conversation and support space.
Great for honest talk, life questions, venting, or Korean practice.
shipping: A call time will be arranged within 3–5 days after your order. No physical shipment involved.
care: Make sure you’re in a comfortable, quiet place during the call. JJ will do the same.
